identity.title: Probing fragmentation and velocity sub-structure in the massive NGC 6334 filament with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We conducted ALMA Band 3 observations in the 3.1 mm continuum and of the N$_2$H$^+$(1-0), HC$_5$N(36-35), HNC(1-0), HC$_3$N(10-9), CH$_3$CCH(6-5), and H$_2$CS(3-2) lines

evidence.quote: corresponding to 0.025 pc at a distance of 1.7 kpc.

question.value: What are the density (core) and velocity sub-structure and fragmentation properties of the massive NGC 6334 main filament, and how do they compare with low-mass filaments such as Taurus B211/B213?

evidence.quote: we investigate the detailed density and velocity structure of the main filament in the high-mass star-forming region NGC 6334.
as part of project 2015.1.01404.S (PI: Ph. Andr$\acute{\rm e}$)
We carried out ALMA Cycle 3 observations in Band 3 toward NGC 6334

evidence.quote: The N$_2$H$^+$(1–0) line was observed in narrow-band mode at a frequency resolution of 61.035 kHz, corresponding to $\sim\,$0.2 km s$^{-1}$.
We imaged the main filament in the NGC 6334 region using a 17-pointing mosaic with the 12m array and a 8-pointing mosaic with the ACA array.

results_numeric.quantity: Compact continuum sources identified / embedded in filament

evidence.quote: we identified a total of 40 candidate compact 3.1 mm continuum sources
The median mass of the 26 compact continuum sources embedded in the main filament is $9.6^{+3.0}_{-1.9}$ $M_{\odot}$
their median volume-averaged density 1.6$\times$10$^{7}$ cm$^{-3}$
The 5$\sigma$ mass sensitivity of the ALMA 12m continuum data for compact sources is $\sim$$2.0\, M_{\odot}$
we identified five distinct fiber-like structures, labeled F-1 to F-5
Their typical length is 0.5$\pm$0.4 pc
the typical velocity difference between them is 0.8 km s$^{-1}$
the mean separation between observed cores ($0.04\pm 0.01$ pc)

estimated 90% completeness level ($2.6\, M_{\odot}$)

findings_qualitative.value: Cores are grouped into seven groups associated with ArTéMiS clumps, suggesting bimodal fragmentation

evidence.quote: These two distinct separation scales are suggestive of a bimodal fragmentation process in the filament.

findings_qualitative.value: Only F-1 and F-2 may be genuine fibers; others may be accretion flows

evidence.quote: the other two features may trace accretion flows onto the main filament.
